prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original full-body hero portrait cutout for an industrial fantasy action RPG set in abandoned deep mine networks.
Primary request: Design ONE completely original adult male signal technician hero, Gu Pin, "The Frequency Gatherer", a thoughtful node-deploying resonance specialist. Premium richly hand-painted game character concept illustration, sophisticated believable handmade mining mechanisms and selectively rich material detail. He must feel curious, gentle, technically capable and warmly human, with his own memorable face and an asymmetric equipment silhouette. Entirely original design, no reference to any existing IP.
Subject: Adult East Asian man around 40, soft rounded yet weathered face, kind slightly hooded amber-brown eyes, broad nose, short wavy dark hair with a subtle grey streak, a short neat moustache and small chin beard, focused faint smile as though listening to a humming machine. Average slightly compact build, dressed in a practical aged-white SHORT utility field jacket with peacock-teal reinforced panels, dark brown belted work trousers, padded knees and stout work boots; fitted layered sleeves and fingerless technician gloves. His jacket ends above mid-thigh; absolutely NO wizard robe or long coat. Design a large circular offset SIGNAL RECEIVER on one shoulder of the backpack, clearly a dished perforated radio receiver with a copper tuning ring, plus FOUR capacitor cylinders with staggered heights on the opposite side; ceramic insulators, cable connections and tiny teal lit ports. Exposed backpack cables route naturally to two folded triangular deployable NODE units clipped neatly at his hips, each a compact copper/ceramic tripod mechanism with mineral core. All these objects remain part of a single character, no detached secondary subjects.
Weapon: A SHORT-HANDLED fork-shaped needle emitter held ready in one hand at the side, fully visible and clearly shorter than his leg, twin narrow metal tines surrounding a tiny turquoise crystal spark; handcrafted brass brackets, aged white ceramic body, a thick cable routed back to his backpack. His free hand holds a small tuning knob near his chest, believable five-finger hand anatomy. No magic wand, staff, spell book, futuristic assault rifle, or enormous weapon.
Palette: aged white #D2D1BB, peacock teal #3E8D8D, dark brown #4B443D, restrained oxidized copper and slate, subtle amber indicator and mineral teal luminescence. Surfaces show brushed metal, crazed ceramic, carefully sewn heavy cloth, practical repaired seams and controlled mine dust, no excessive grime obscuring craftsmanship.
Style/light: painterly sculptural volumetric light, precise appealing face, coherent human anatomy, sophisticated hand-painted material rendering with fine detail concentrated on face, receiver, capacitors and emitter, sharp readable silhouette, warm key plus a quiet cool rim. This must be an elegant premium illustrated game portrait rather than photorealistic cosplay.
Composition: single figure ONLY, vertical portrait, FULL BODY at three-quarter view with top of receiver, head, equipment, hands, entire emitter and both feet completely inside frame. Comfortable relaxed listening stance. Generous 8-percent clear margins on every side; figure fills about 82 percent of height. No secondary views or inset illustrations.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha cutout, NO ground or base, NO shadow floor, NO scenery, NO colored background or backdrop.
Avoid: ALL text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, signature, watermark, frame, interface; no chibi, no anime, no photo, no traditional robed wizard, no heroic military power armor, no generic glowing rings around hands, no existing character resemblance.
refinement_prompt: Edit this exact original character illustration. Change ONLY the framing: zoom the complete character and all his equipment out slightly to occupy 82 percent of the image height, centered, with a genuinely transparent alpha border of about 8 percent at both top and bottom. Preserve the exact face, short grey-streaked hair, warm expression, pose, white/teal technician short jacket, round copper receiver, four staggered capacitors, two belt nodes, short forked needle emitter, existing painterly materials and all proportions. The top rim of the circular receiver and soles of both boots must be fully intact and clearly separated from the image edges. Maintain TRUE transparency everywhere outside the figure: no background, no floor, no halo, no drop shadow, no pedestal. No text, no additions, no secondary views. Keep the canvas a vertical portrait.
refinement_reason: Increase safe margins around the complete silhouette and attached equipment without changing identity or design.
originality_note: Original industrial-fantasy mining character based on this project's hero visual specification. No existing game or artist reference used.

qa.visual_review: Single fully clothed adult character, full body and complete equipment visible, readable original mining-tool silhouette, no text or logos.
qa.alpha_review: RGBA alpha checked via System.Drawing: transparent outer canvas; visible shape bounds sampled every 4 pixels at alpha > 16.
qa.limitations: Portrait artwork only. Does not supply direction-specific gameplay sprites, rigs, or attack animation frames.
